title: One row can add many reachable nodes
hook: A whole destination row is useful only after its starting point is reachable.

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
Binary masks, basic complex arithmetic for FFT, polynomial coefficients.
doesNotKnow: Compute transitive closure with row-bitset unions gated by reachability to the current intermediate vertex.

misconception: Every graph reachability update needs an individual operation per destination.
objective: Compute transitive closure with row-bitset unions gated by reachability to the current intermediate vertex.

claims.text: A row may import the intermediate vertex’s destinations only if it already reaches that intermediate. The OR operation adds several destinations together. Processing intermediates systematically computes all-pairs reachability; the diagonal here explicitly includes each vertex reaching itself.
